sci.animals.birds.L1: The greater adjutant stork nests in tall village trees in Assam. A group of village women called the Hargila Army protects the storks and their nests.
sci.changes.fire.L3: On 14 April, Fire Service Day, fire stations in India remember the firefighters who died fighting a great fire at the Bombay docks in 1944.
sci.chemistry.electrochemistry.L4: The Iron Pillar in the Qutb complex in Delhi has stood in the open for about 1,600 years with very little rust.
sci.materials.magnetic-materials.L3: The Delhi Iron Pillar at Mehrauli is nearly 1,600 years old and made of almost pure iron.
sci.materials.properties.L3: The Iron Pillar in Delhi near the Qutub Minar is about 1,600 years old and still stands with very little rust.
sci.ecology.populations.L5: Fishing boats in India stay in harbour during the yearly fishing ban in the monsoon, when many fish breed.
sci.electricity.uses-of-electricity.L2: At the Barefoot College in Tilonia, Rajasthan, grandmothers from villages around the world learn to build and fix solar lamps for their own villages.
sci.environment.caring.L1: Sikkim was one of the first states in India to ban plastic bags, in 1998.
sci.evolution.closest-cousins.L5: In the forests of Assam, hoolock gibbons sing loud duets at dawn. They are India's only apes.
Mysuru Zoo is the only zoo in India with gorillas. Orangutans live there too.
Lion-tailed macaques cross the road at Valparai in Tamil Nadu. They are monkeys who live only in the Western Ghats.
sci.evolution.family-tree-of-life.L5: Dugongs graze on seagrass in Palk Bay. Tamil Nadu made part of the bay a dugong reserve in 2022. Their nearest living relatives are elephants.
In the first rains of the monsoon in Kerala, the purple frog comes up from underground for a few days. Its nearest relatives live on the Seychelles islands.
Fossils of early whales have been found in Kutch in Gujarat and in Kashmir. Parts of India lay beside a warm, shallow sea when whales were first taking to the water.
sci.evolution.fossils-and-extinction.L5: Many old forts of Maharashtra are built of dark Deccan basalt, the lava rock from the time of the last dinosaurs.
sci.evolution.human-origins.L5: Robert Bruce Foote found the first stone hand axe in India at Pallavaram in 1863. You can see stone hand axes at the Government Museum in Egmore, Chennai.
Near Chennai, at Attirampakkam, people made hand axes about 1.5 million years ago. No bones were found, so nobody knows which kind of human they were.
On the bank of the Narmada at Hathnora in Madhya Pradesh, the top of an ancient human skull was found in 1982.
sci.genetics.dna-and-rna.L3: At the Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology in Hyderabad, Lalji Singh's team began DNA fingerprinting in India in the 1980s.
sci.materials.natural-and-made.L2: Many glass bangles are made in Firozabad, in Uttar Pradesh.
sci.materials.using-materials.L2: Much of India's coir is made in Kerala.
sci.materials.using-materials.L3: In Assam and Mizoram, whole houses are built of bamboo.
sci.sky.exploring-space.L3: The Space Museum at Thumba, near Thiruvananthapuram, is in the old church where India's rocket story began.
sci.sky.stargazing.L1: Hanle in Ladakh is India's first Dark Sky Reserve. The sky is so dark that the Milky Way shines over the hills.
sci.sky.the-sun.L3: The Konark Sun Temple in Odisha is built as the Sun's chariot, with great stone wheels.
sci.sky.the-sun.L4: A total solar eclipse was seen in India on 22 July 2009.
sci.story-of-universe.black-holes.L3: LIGO-India, a gravitational-wave detector, is being built near Aundha Nagnath in Hingoli district, Maharashtra.
sci.waste.sorting-waste.L3: In Kerala, the women of the Haritha Karma Sena, in green uniforms, collect dry waste from homes.
sci.water.water-sources-and-uses.L1: Rani ki Vav in Patan, Gujarat, is a stepwell more than 900 years old, with steps going far down to the water.
math.probability.likely-and-unlikely.L1: Snakes and ladders is a game that began in India. In Tamil Nadu it is called Paramapadam.
